## 🎯 **One-Time Reference: Key Information**

### **Week 6 File Structure** (Copy this template)
```
daily_study/
└── rust_learning_week6_notes/
    ├── Cargo.toml
    ├── README.md
    ├── Day29.md          # Concepts only
    ├── Day29.rs          # Executable code
    ├── Day30.md          # Concepts only
    ├── Day30.rs          # Executable code
    ├── ... (continue for Days 31-35)
    └── examples/         # Optional
```

### **DayX.md Contains** ✅
- Learning Focus (1 line)
- Learning Objectives (3-5 items)
- Core Concepts (theory)
- Trait Bounds & Patterns
- Advanced Patterns (conceptual)
- Real-World Applications (conceptual)
- Zettelkasten Connections
- Tags

### **DayX.md Does NOT Contain** ❌
- Large code blocks
- Complete runnable examples
- Executable code

### **DayX.rs Contains** ✅
- File header comment
- Imports (complete)
- Example 1: Basic Concept
- Example 2: Key Feature
- Example 3: Real-World Application
- Examples 4-7: Additional Patterns
- Helper functions/structs
- Main function with sections

### **DayX.rs Must**
- Compile: `rustc DayX.rs` ✅
- Run: `./DayX.exe` (no panics) ✅
- Copy to Rust Playground and run ✅
- Have no clippy warnings ✅
